name: design-with-ai
description: Design, critique, and refine cohesive product interfaces with AI.

interface.shortDescription: Design cohesive interfaces without generic AI output.
interface.longDescription: A systems-oriented workflow for designing, critiquing, and refining product interfaces with clear constraints, meaningful alternatives, reusable components, and realistic validation.
defaultPrompt: Design a coherent interface from these product requirements.
Critique this interface and identify its systemic design problems.
Refine this product flow without adding unnecessary UI.
